CustomField.description: Captures the full website intake-form submission as structured text. Set automatically by the Netlify Function for submissions from sftsinc.com /get-help.html (full intake form). Includes safety status, urgency, household composition, needs, disabilities, story, referral source, and consent acknowledgment in human-readable form. Advocates use this to triage and then transfer relevant data to structured fields.
CustomField.label: Website Submission Notes
